heroSubheading: How we handle and protect your personal information when you browse our Barcelona Flamenco Show guide.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
sections.body:
This website is an independent travel guide and booking comparison resource dedicated to helping visitors discover and book authentic Barcelona flamenco shows, historic tablaos, and dinner packages in Barcelona, Spain.

We are not a direct tour operator or ticketing agency. Bookings initiated through our links are processed by our trusted partner GetYourGuide, governed by their respective privacy terms and security protocols.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We do not collect or store sensitive personal information such as credit card details or home addresses directly on our servers. When you use this website, we may receive:

  • Usage Data: Anonymized analytical data regarding pages visited, browser type, device information, and referral sources.
  • Direct Inquiries: Any email address or contact details you provide voluntarily when reaching out via our contact form or support email.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Analytics
sections.body: We use standard, industry-compliant cookies and Google Analytics to measure aggregate visitor metrics and improve site performance. You can choose to disable or block cookies through your individual browser settings at any time without restricting your access to our content.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Booking Partners
sections.body: When you click on a ticket booking link to purchase flamenco tickets, you are redirected to authorized ticketing partners (such as GetYourGuide). These third parties manage checkout security, payment handling, and ticket voucher dispatch according to their own strict privacy standards (GDPR compliant).

sections.heading: 5. Contact & Data Inquiries
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to request information regarding any data you have submitted to us, please contact us at livetravelpartner@gmail.com.

metaTitle: Privacy Policy | Barcelona Flamenco Show Booking Guide
metaDescription: Read our privacy policy to understand how we protect your information when researching Barcelona flamenco shows and booking tickets.
